guidebook.intro: Yogera ku by’onyumirwa: okudduka, okuwuga, omupiira, ennyimba n’emizannyo.

tips.title: “I enjoy reading”
body: Oluvannyuma lwa **enjoy** ekikolwa kyongerwako **-ing**: **I enjoy reading. I enjoy running.** Ne **like** kisobola: **I like swimming** oba **I like to swim**.

tips.title: “Has won”
body: Ku kintu ekibaddewo kati kati: **My team has won!** Okubuuza: **Who has won?** oba **Who won?**
Ku mupiira: **a goal, two goals**, **a team**, **a game**.

culture.title: The Cranes
body: Ttiimu y’omupiira eya Uganda eyitibwa **the Cranes**, okuva ku ngaali. Abawagizi baleekaana: **Come on, Cranes!** **Goal!**
